info.title: Commercefull API
info.description: Auto-generated OpenAPI specification for the Commercefull platform REST API.

get.summary: GET /business/analytics/sales/dashboard - Get sales dashboard with summary
GET /business/analytics/events/counts - Get event counts by period

Resolve collection products (manual or smart)
GET /business/assortment/collections/:collectionId/products

List collection visibility publications (store/channel scoping)
GET /business/assortment/collections/:collectionId/publications

post.summary:
Create or update a collection publication for a store/channel scope
POST /business/assortment/collections/:collectionId/publications

get.summary:
Get store assortment config + entries
GET /business/assortment/stores/:storeId

put.summary:
Set assortment mode (all | include | exclude)
PUT /business/assortment/stores/:storeId

post.summary:
Add assortment entry (product | collection | category)
POST /business/assortment/stores/:storeId/entries

get.summary:
Get collection page by slug (metadata + resolved products)
GET /customer/assortment/collections/:slug

post.summary:
Get or create basket for current user/session
POST /basket

Merge baskets (typically when guest logs in)
POST /basket/merge

delete.summary:
Clear all items from basket
DELETE /basket/:basketId/items

get.summary:
Get available payment methods (no checkout required)
GET /checkout/payment-methods

Get available pickup time slots
GET /checkout/:checkoutId/pickup-slots

put.summary:
Set fulfillment method (shipping, pickup, local_delivery, digital)
PUT /checkout/:checkoutId/fulfillment-method

Set customer VAT ID (B2B reverse charge)
PUT /checkout/:checkoutId/vat-number

post.summary:
Create payment intent and draft order
POST /checkout/:checkoutId/payment-intent

Complete checkout and create order
POST /checkout/:checkoutId/complete

get.summary: Get active system configuration (must be before /:configId to avoid matching "active" as an ID)
Public content routes (no auth required, only published/active content)

GET /identity/social/:provider/config
Get OAuth configuration for a provider (client ID, auth URL, scopes)

delete.summary:
DELETE /identity/social/:provider/customer/unlink
Unlink a social account from a customer (requires auth)

get.summary:
GET /identity/social/customer/accounts
Get all linked social accounts for a customer (requires auth)

GET /identity/social/merchant/accounts
Get all linked social accounts for a merchant (requires auth)
Admin routes for membership benefit management
Admin routes for user membership management
Admin routes for fetching user-specific membership data
Get benefits for a specific tier

List all orders with filters
GET /business/orders

post.summary:
Create an order on behalf of the organization (POS / manual orders)
POST /business/orders

get.summary:
Get order by order number
GET /business/orders/number/:orderNumber

Get order explainability — market context, version snapshot, decision log
GET /business/orders/:orderId/decisions

Get order by order number
GET /orders/number/:orderNumber

Get transactions for an order
GET /payments/orders/:orderId

Search products with advanced filters and facets
GET /customer/products/search

post.summary:
Search products (POST for complex queries)
POST /customer/products/search

get.summary:
Get search suggestions for autocomplete
GET /customer/products/search/suggestions

Get subcategories of a parent category
GET /customer/categories/:categoryId/children

Get category by ID or slug
GET /customer/categories/:identifier

Find product by variant barcode
GET /customer/products/barcode/:barcode
Flat variant routes — must be before /:productId to avoid collision

delete.summary: G6: kept under the /products topic prefix (was /business/relationships/:id)

get.summary:
Get product by ID or slug
GET /products/:identifier
Customer profiles (must be before /segment/:segmentId to avoid param matching)

post.summary: Calculate shipping rates for an order
Estimate delivery time for a shipping method

get.summary: Get active stores (must be before :storeId to avoid collision)
Resolve the market context for this hostname (+ optional currency/locale overrides)
Explicit market selection for the storefront market switcher
NEW: Get public tax settings for storefront

post.summary:
Register a new webhook endpoint
POST /business/webhooks

get.summary:
Get a single webhook endpoint
GET /business/webhooks/:webhookEndpointId

Get deliveries for a webhook endpoint
GET /business/webhooks/:webhookEndpointId/deliveries
